sourceNotes.referenceTitle: Kashmiri Red Meenakari Tulip Kundan Bracelet Watch
sourceNotes.rawContent: Dripping in tradition and grace — this striking Kashmiri bracelet watch features bold red meenakari tulip motifs with teardrop kundan centres, elegantly framing a classic white quartz dial. Triple gold chains adorned with cascading ghungroo bells on both ends create a dramatic yet deeply rooted Indian aesthetic. A must-have for brides, festival queens, and every woman who wears her culture like jewellery
